description: usage/<label>.json in bee's registry folder: the last usage window an account's status line saw, written whole by bee's status-line hook (src/beethoven_agents/bee/handoff.py) whenever Claude Code sends either window. Percentages are whole numbers from 0 to 100, null when Claude Code sent none for that window; reset times are epoch seconds, 0 when Claude Code sent none. session_id is what Claude Code named the session. A reader treats a file it cannot read as no reading.
title: UsageReading
